## Context
`make lint` deterministically prints: `WARN audit: zizmor is running in offline mode by default; some audits and auto-fixes will not be available.` The gate still exits successfully, so contributors can report a clean lint run while the tool says part of its audit surface is unavailable. A tracker search for `zizmor offline mode` found no open bug owning the warning. Discovered while verifying `treelike-unamusing-grosbeak`.

## Reproduction
From a provisioned checkout, run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` and inspect the zizmor step.

## Plan
Use `rebar-debug` to identify exactly which audits are disabled offline, whether Gerrit CI has network/capabilities to run them, and whether the current invocation is deliberate. If changing online/offline policy affects portability, network access, or CI behavior, return an evidence-backed decision brief rather than silently choosing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Root cause and the exact unavailable audit capabilities are proven against the pinned zizmor version.
- [x] Local/no-network and Gerrit CI behavior are both evaluated.
- [x] The warning is eliminated by a reviewed policy or explicitly documented/suppressed only if the warning is proven intentional and coverage-equivalent safeguards are cited.
- [x] `make lint` and relevant workflow gates remain green.
